features.name: 所有主导航与返回
features.expectedOutcome: Notes、Labels、Unlabeled、Archived、Deleted、Reminders、Settings 与指定标签页显示各自数据集合，返回栈正确。
acceptancePoints: Verify destination-specific title AND expected included/excluded unique note markers.
Folder/label filters are computed independently from BaseNote.folder and decoded labels; navigation does not alter rows.

features.name: 文本笔记创建、修改与保存
features.expectedOutcome: 标题与正文中文、多行、符号精确保留，同一笔记修改保持id，返回重开可读。
acceptancePoints: Exactly one captured note ID has type NOTE, folder NOTES, exact title/body and sensible modifiedTimestamp.
Overview and editor display the same unique marker and full multi-line body.

features.name: 清单父项、子项、编辑与层级
features.expectedOutcome: 父项和子项关系、正文与顺序持久保存，缩进/取消缩进不丢任务。
acceptancePoints: Decode the complete BaseNote.items array and compare exact body/checked/isChild/order/checkedTimestamp fields, serialized sequence and parent/child grouping against the fixture. Use distinct fixture body markers plus multiplicity to detect loss or duplication; ListItem.id is not persisted.
Expected indentation and four visible task markers; none duplicated or lost.

features.name: 父子勾选与批量勾选
features.expectedOutcome: 父项勾选同步子项，子项变化按父子规则更新；check all/uncheck all反映每个任务状态。
acceptancePoints: Verify checked and checkedTimestamp per item plus derived parent state, independently decoding items.
Checkbox state, checked-section placement and parent state match persisted items.

features.name: 任务拖动和整组移动
features.expectedOutcome: 移动父项时子项保持所属；顺序保存，拖动撤销不丢任务。
acceptancePoints: Compare the complete ordered sequence of body/checked/isChild/order/checkedTimestamp tuples and reconstructed parent groups against the planned move. Every fixture body occurrence must appear exactly once in its expected position/group; no durable item ID exists.
Task bodies and indentation match expected order.

features.name: 删除勾选项与恢复编辑历史
features.expectedOutcome: 只删除勾选集合，未勾选任务保留；编辑会话内Undo/Redo得到预期集合。
acceptancePoints: Remaining exact body/checked/isChild/order/checkedTimestamp tuples, serialized sequence and parent grouping equal the planned deletion result. Compare the full surviving task multiset, including duplicate-body multiplicity, rather than invented task IDs.
Count and markers agree after delete/undo/redo.

features.name: 标签创建、改名、删除
features.expectedOutcome: Label实体与所有关联笔记同步，删除标签不删除笔记正文。
acceptancePoints: Read Label table and decoded BaseNote.labels: rename propagates exactly, deletion removes association but preserves note IDs/body.
Label navigation shows matching set only; a must not match ab by substring.

features.name: 单篇和多选标签赋值
features.expectedOutcome: 单篇选择及多选三态标签只影响预期笔记；未触及标签保持原状。
acceptancePoints: Exact per-note label arrays match selected/unchecked/unchanged tri-state rules.
Label chips, DisplayLabel and Unlabeled membership agree.

features.name: 标题、正文、任务、标签搜索与范围
features.expectedOutcome: 命中真实业务文字且限制当前folder/标签/无标签范围，不命中JSON字段名。
acceptancePoints: Expected matching IDs computed from decoded business fields and folder/label predicate, not SQL LIKE output alone.
Actual visible result IDs/texts equal expected set.

features.name: 固定笔记与颜色
features.expectedOutcome: 固定/取消固定影响分组；颜色赋值、编辑和替换改变正确记录。
acceptancePoints: BaseNote.pinned and color equal selected values; color replacement affects exactly matching original color rows.
Pinned group and color swatches match records.

features.name: 复制笔记与副本隔离
features.expectedOutcome: 复制建立新id且复制内容，副本编辑不污染原件。
acceptancePoints: New distinct ID; title gains the localized copy suffix and timestamps reset per source; other initial business content equals source; subsequent edit changes only duplicate.

For attachment-bearing variant, compare shared attachment references and bytes, because duplicateNotes deep-copies metadata without copying files; source attachments must remain valid. For no-attachment variants, explicitly prove both reference sets empty.
Original and duplicate separately open with expected content.

features.name: 归档与取消归档
features.expectedOutcome: 同一id在NOTES/ARCHIVED移动，正文标签附件不变；离开Notes时相关通知被取消。
acceptancePoints: Same ID; folder NOTES→ARCHIVED→NOTES and all content fields preserved.
Membership matches both folders.
If note has pinned notification/reminder fixture, verify cancellation when archived.

features.name: 回收站与恢复
features.expectedOutcome: 软删除移动至DELETED；恢复返回NOTES，数据及附件可用。
acceptancePoints: Same ID and content; folder NOTES→DELETED→NOTES.
Referenced attachments still exist and retain hashes after soft delete/restore.
Notes and Deleted membership match folder transitions.

features.name: 永久删除、取消与批量撤销窗口
features.expectedOutcome: 取消保留笔记；确认删除删除目标行并清理对应附件，其他笔记不受影响。
acceptancePoints: Target row absent after confirmed final deletion; Undo restores selected rows before finalization.
Cleanup follows actual snackbar finalization, and files referenced by unaffected notes remain usable.
Deleted folder and notification state reflect final operation.

features.name: 多选、全选与上下文菜单
features.expectedOutcome: 各folder提供正确操作，多选仅影响选中id，单项分享只在选择1项可见。
acceptancePoints: Only captured selected ID set changes; unselected canonical snapshot stable.
Selection count, folder-specific menu availability and single-selection share rule match source.

features.name: 文本与清单双向转换
features.expectedOutcome: type与body/items按原转换规则变化，id及附件/标签保留；不承诺富文本/层级无损往返。
acceptancePoints: Same ID, expected NOTE/LIST type, exact resulting body/items according to pinned source; labels/attachments preserved.
Correct editor opens and every expected line/item is visible.

features.name: 撤销重做、只读模式与快速跳转
features.expectedOutcome: 编辑会话内Undo/Redo精确回退内容，只读不接受编辑，顶部/底部跳转不改数据。
acceptancePoints: Saved body matches last intended edit; viewMode correct; navigation alone does not alter content.
Caret/scroll and disabled editing state match requested operation.

features.name: 富文本格式与范围
features.expectedOutcome: 粗体、斜体、等宽、删除线和清除格式作用于预期文字范围；正文和span可重开读取。
acceptancePoints: Verify exact body plus normalized span ranges/styles; UTF-16 indices must stay within body length.
Screenshot visibly confirms requested styles and unchanged unselected text; tree alone cannot prove font styling.

features.name: 外部链接与内部笔记链接
features.expectedOutcome: 链接添加、编辑、复制、移除保持正确显示文字与目标；内部链接打开指定note ID。
acceptancePoints: Inspect URL spans and internal note target IDs, preserving unrelated spans/body.
Clipboard or resolved ACTION_VIEW target equals expected URL; capture outbound intent only.
Internal navigation title/body match the linked ID, not merely any editor.
environmentRequirements: 可用浏览器或可验证Activity intent；clipboard读取条件

features.name: 编辑页搜索与工具栏动作布局
features.expectedOutcome: 搜索前后命中位置正确；自定义顶部/底部动作可持久恢复并仍可从More访问动作。
acceptancePoints: editNoteActivityTopActions/bottomActions store expected action identifiers, no illegal duplicates from customization.
Searching/customization does not change note content.
Match count/selection and actual toolbar action agree with chosen identifiers.

features.name: 外部文本文件查看、编辑保存、转换为笔记
features.expectedOutcome: VIEW文件进入独立编辑，Save写回来源，Save to device另存，Convert建立笔记。
acceptancePoints: Original URI bytes and separately saved bytes match intended UTF-8 payload; original unchanged for save-as-only variant.
Conversion creates expected NOTE; editing external file alone must not create phantom notes.
File editor/note editor transitions and content match selected operation.
environmentRequirements: 可读写与只读DocumentProvider fixture

features.name: 分享笔记与接收系统分享
features.expectedOutcome: 分享选中内容使用正确MIME/URI；接收文本或多个附件建立对应笔记且能保存。
acceptancePoints: Independent chooser/intent capture verifies payload, MIME and read grants; no external message sent.
Received note has exact expected title/body/attachment references.
Imported attachment bytes equal fixture hashes.
environmentRequirements: 本地测试发送器/受控ContentProvider

features.name: 超长正文与历史大笔记拆分
features.expectedOutcome: 交互保存按insertSafe上限截断并提示；导入/历史迁移拆分按源码规则生成多段，不能混淆两条合同。
acceptancePoints: For UI save compare exact allowed prefix and clipped valid spans; for import concatenate ordered chunks to original and verify expected titles/IDs.
Truncation/split feedback corresponds to actual persistent result.
environmentRequirements: 隔离数据目录与大型/历史DB fixture

features.name: 标签导航顺序、隐藏与显示上限
features.expectedOutcome: 拖动排序影响导航顺序；隐藏标签也会从Notes概览过滤含该标签的笔记（原基线行为），持久标签归属及正文不变。
acceptancePoints: Label.order changes exactly for intended reorder; BaseNote.labels/body unchanged.
Hidden-label set and maxLabels match user choices.

Navigation includes/excludes exact labels in expected order, More appears when needed; Notes overview excludes any note with a hidden label per original BaseNoteModel.initBaseNotes, without deleting its DB row.

features.name: 主题、视图、字体与日期时间显示
features.expectedOutcome: 列表/网格、四种主题与动态色、编辑/概览字体及日期时间分别生效，业务数据不变。
acceptancePoints: Exact preference keys and enum/numeric values equal requested choice.
Canonical business snapshot identical across presentation changes.
Layout, actual text size and formatted timestamps match explicit locale/timezone; visual styles require screenshot review.

features.name: 排序、起始页、默认清单模式与自动保存
features.expectedOutcome: 排序字段/升降序、勾选自动排序、起始页、默认清单模式及空闲保存按设置执行。
acceptancePoints: NotesSortBy/order, startView, listItemSorting, defaultListView and autoSaveAfterIdle persist exactly.
Independently compute expected order from business fields; idle-save query observes committed body after configured threshold.
Actual order, launch destination and readonly/edit affordance match requested values.

features.name: 概览内容密度与隐藏标签/图片
features.expectedOutcome: 标题/正文/清单展示上限和隐藏内容只改变概览，不丢真实内容。
acceptancePoints: maxTitle/maxItems/maxLines and overview hidden flags reflect choices.
Full body/items/attachment references unchanged.
Overview obeys requested limits and detail shows full data, not a truncated stored value.

features.name: 图片添加、浏览、分享、保存与删除
features.expectedOutcome: 选中图片复制到当前存储，预览和图片页动作指向同一文件；删除只影响目标附件。
acceptancePoints: BaseNote.images metadata/references match imported images and final deletion set.
Stored/exported image hashes equal source fixtures; unrelated/shared referenced files remain valid.
Rendered pictures independently visually match fixtures; pager order and delete outcome agree.
environmentRequirements: SAF图片fixtures含坏文件及撤销授权URI

features.name: 一般文件添加、打开、导出与删除
features.expectedOutcome: 不同MIME文件保留名称/内容与引用；外部打开使用正确URI权限，删除清理正确。
acceptancePoints: FileAttachment metadata and final reference set match selected documents.
Distinct source bytes survive name collisions; unrelated references and source documents unchanged.
ACTION_VIEW has expected MIME/read grant; actual handler reads correct file.
environmentRequirements: SAF文档fixtures与可用/不可用MIME处理器

features.name: 录音暂停恢复、播放、导出与删除
features.expectedOutcome: 音频录制可暂停/继续并保存，播放暂停/seek/后台服务使用同一音频；导出删除正确。
acceptancePoints: Audio metadata duration/name and note reference match saved file and final deletion set.
Audio container decodes, duration/timeline match pause behavior; exported hash matches saved audio.
Foreground microphone/playback service and notification lifecycle end appropriately.
Playback progress controls match media timeline; known content must be heard/decoded independently, not just nonzero bytes.
environmentRequirements: 麦克风权限控制、可识别声源及独立听感/解码验证；后台服务状态读取

features.name: 单篇与多选导出五种格式
features.expectedOutcome: TXT/MD/PDF/JSON/HTML产物真实可解析，单篇与批量命名、内容和所选集合正确。
acceptancePoints: Independent parser checks format-specific exact content; PDF rendered page/text plus screenshot inspection; compare selected set and collision-safe names.
Export leaves all notes and attachment references unchanged.
Picker/format choice and actual file type agree.
environmentRequirements: SAF输出目录、宿主TXT/MD/JSON/HTML/PDF解析器

features.name: 整库ZIP备份与导入合并
features.expectedOutcome: 备份包含可恢复业务数据库及引用附件；导入合并保留语义，重复处理与内部链接重映射按基线。
acceptancePoints: Open ZIP independently; read coherent embedded DB, enumerate referenced attachments and hashes, reject extra unreferenced payload as imported data.
Canonical business graph matches fixture under documented ID remap, duplicate policy and reminder state.
Imported reminder/pin scheduling corresponds to imported notes only.
environmentRequirements: 隔离数据快照与ZIP fixture

features.name: 备份密码设置、加密ZIP与错误密码
features.expectedOutcome: 备份密码影响ZIP加密，正确密码恢复；错误/空密码不冒充成功。
acceptancePoints: ZIP encryption flags and independent decryption behavior match setting, bytes/content match expected fixture.
Correct-password import restores exact business graph; encrypted backup never accepted solely from file existence.
Password configured/cleared state verified without recording secret value.
environmentRequirements: 支持AES ZIP的宿主解析器、隔离测试密码

features.name: 旧XML/SQLite备份兼容导入
features.expectedOutcome: 旧XML与ZIP内旧SQLite缺可选字段时使用明确默认值，转换保留可表达内容。
acceptancePoints: Imported rows exactly match independently parsed legacy fixture and documented defaults.
Temporary imports cleaned after successful/error completion; original backup unchanged.
environmentRequirements: 版本化XML与SQLite ZIP fixtures

features.name: 五类外部格式导入
features.expectedOutcome: Google Keep、Evernote、Quillpad、纯文本与JSON的支持字段/附件按各解析器导入。
acceptancePoints: Exact decoded content/labels/items/attachments compare to per-format fixture expectation; no assumed universal lossless mapping.
Imported supported attachments hash-match source; unsupported/missing fields explicitly reported.
environmentRequirements: 5类本地fixture，不需要真实云账号

features.name: 自动备份目录、保存触发、周期与保留数
features.expectedOutcome: 已授权目录才启用自动备份，保存/周期触发生成可恢复产物，保留数与最近执行时间可核对。
acceptancePoints: backupsFolder/onSave/period/enabled/max/lastExecution match requested and observed state.
Actual archive contents reflect committed note; newest retained files count and chronology match configured retention.
Unique WorkManager work state/interval/cancellation correspond to settings; scheduling alone is not execution proof.
environmentRequirements: SAF持久授权目录、WorkManager状态读取、可观察实际执行窗口

features.name: 缺失附件备份反馈与后台清理
features.expectedOutcome: 备份跳过缺失附件时明确列出，清理动作只移除确实缺失的引用。
acceptancePoints: Only missing attachment metadata removed; valid attachment references and all note text remain.
Existing two hashes unchanged; archive missing-entry accounting exact.
Cleanup completion counts and notification correspond to actual affected notes.
environmentRequirements: 隔离附件目录故障fixture与WorkManager/通知访问

features.name: 设置JSON导入导出与重置
features.expectedOutcome: 设置JSON按允许字段恢复，安全密钥不会由普通导出泄漏；重置保留业务数据并正确处理锁/存储相关状态。
acceptancePoints: Export JSON contains intended nonsensitive preferences and excludes biometricLock/iv/databaseEncryptionKey keys; inspect encrypted preference handling without exposing secrets.
Imported/default values match pinned source policy, including retained/migrated lock/storage fields.
Canonical notes/labels and accessible attachment graph preserved after reset.
environmentRequirements: 设置JSON fixtures；锁组合需生物识别环境

features.name: 提醒创建、编辑、删除与重复规则
features.expectedOutcome: 提醒ID/时刻/重复字段持久保存；一次和重复提醒实际送达，编辑删除更新调度。
acceptancePoints: Reminder id/dateTime/repetition/value/unit/occurrence/dayOfWeek match exact user choice and delete set.
AlarmManager and delivered notification target correct note/reminder; next repeat calculated independently with explicit timezone/DST fixture.
Reminder list/chip and notification opened note match persisted IDs.
environmentRequirements: 通知和exact-alarm权限、短期实际触发窗口；DST/重启需扩展环境

features.name: 通知/精确闹钟拒绝与重启恢复
features.expectedOutcome: 权限被拒绝或撤销时实际状态可解释；授权后/BOOT_COMPLETED恢复符合当前库的提醒与固定通知。
acceptancePoints: After real boot, exact alarm and notification IDs match eligible NOTES records; no duplicate or deleted-note alerts.
Reminder data preserved and visibility flags correspond to observed notification state.
environmentRequirements: 可重启专用设备、通知/精确闹钟权限控制；root设备窗口授权

features.name: 固定到通知栏与通知动作
features.expectedOutcome: 固定/取消固定及Open/Delete动作绑定正确笔记，正文变化刷新通知，归档/删除取消。
acceptancePoints: isPinnedToStatus and folder reflect exact requested action on captured note ID.
Notification tag/id/text/action target correspond to note; cancelled notifications absent.
Opened editor matches unique target marker.
environmentRequirements: 通知权限与状态栏/系统通知读取

features.name: 桌面Widget选择、显示、勾选、重配与删除
features.expectedOutcome: Widget实例映射正确笔记，显示正文/清单，勾选修改正确任务，重配/删除更新实例配置。
acceptancePoints: widget:<appWidgetId>/widgetNoteType mapping matches OS instance; removed instance keys gone.

Widget action changes the intended task occurrence identified by the observed position, fixture body marker and parent group; compare the full persisted body/checked/isChild/order/checkedTimestamp sequence and multiplicity. Other notes/tasks remain unchanged; ListItem.id is not persisted.
AppWidgetManager active IDs and provider correspond to actual launcher widgets.
Launcher screenshot/UIA shows expected note content and checkbox state, not merely app overview.
environmentRequirements: 支持该AppWidget的launcher与桌面UIA；锁组合需生物识别

features.name: 生物识别锁、SQLCipher与解锁生命周期
features.expectedOutcome: 启用锁需认证，数据库加密并可认证后读取；后台/屏幕锁/重启门控正常，禁用锁可读回原业务。
acceptancePoints: OS biometric prompt and real success/cancel recorded; authentication cannot be synthesized as pass.
Active DB encryption mode/header changes as source specifies; never print encryption material.
Authorized independent query after unlock returns canonical pre-lock data, and disable preserves all rows/attachments.
Locked screen hides note content; successful unlock restores correct destination.
environmentRequirements: 真实可用生物识别、已录入/未录入测试条件、授权SQLCipher只读oracle

features.name: 禁止截图/最近任务预览设置
features.expectedOutcome: SecureFlag开启时系统阻止应用画面捕获；关闭恢复正常，不影响笔记内容。
acceptancePoints: secureFlag preference matches selected state.
Window FLAG_SECURE and actual screenshot denial/redaction agree; protected screenshot absence is expected evidence.
Canonical note data unchanged.
environmentRequirements: 系统窗口flag/截图结果读取；必要人工观察recent apps

features.name: 内私有与公共目录迁移
features.expectedOutcome: 切换数据库及全部附件到目标存储后再更改设置，目标可读且业务图/文件hash保持。
acceptancePoints: Active DB and attachment roots change as requested; copied coherent DB/attachments remain readable with expected hashes.
Canonical business graph identical before/after each direction, IDs preserved.
dataOnExternalStorage only points to a successfully opened/pinged target; encryption mode preserved.
environmentRequirements: 独立测试目录、空间/权限故障fixture；锁组合需生物识别

features.name: 回收站自动过期清理
features.expectedOutcome: 过期阈值只删除符合时间条件的DELETED笔记及无剩余引用附件，禁用不清理。
acceptancePoints: Deleted ID set equals independent folder+timestamp predicate, boundary compared with pinned DAO operator.
Cleanup respects surviving attachment references.
WorkManager enable/cancel/result agrees with configured days and actual run.
environmentRequirements: 可控时间/旧timestamp fixture与实际WorkManager执行

features.name: 清除全部数据与取消
features.expectedOutcome: 明确确认后删除全库业务数据、标签及不再引用的附件并刷新通知/widget；取消完全保留。
acceptancePoints: BaseNote/Label business tables empty after confirmed clear, unchanged after cancel.
No live attachment data erroneously retained as reachable note content; documented unrelated backups preserved.
Stale reminders/pinned notifications cancelled and widgets reflect missing note; no resurrected records.
environmentRequirements: 只含测试数据的隔离App目录与可恢复备份

features.name: 版本、开源库与日志页面
features.expectedOutcome: 版本与构建一致，Libraries列出源码依赖入口，View logs展示/分享正确日志且不发送消息。
acceptancePoints: Package versionName/code match displayed version.
Viewed/exported logs correspond to current test run, not stale unrelated artifact.
Libraries list and version display match pinned source/build manifest.
environmentRequirements: 可读测试日志

features.name: 反馈、商店、赞助、文档与源码链接
features.expectedOutcome: 各入口构造正确外部URL/邮件草稿，缺处理器时显式失败；不发送/购买/发布。
acceptancePoints: Resolved intent URI/action or draft destination matches pinned source exact target; no form submission, email send or payment.
Business snapshot unchanged.
Return to Settings works after chooser/browser cancellation.
environmentRequirements: 可验证intent目标；无handler变体需隔离配置

features.name: 桌面新建快捷入口
features.expectedOutcome: Launcher快捷入口分别进入文本/清单新建，保存后建立对应type，取消空白遵循空笔记规则。
acceptancePoints: Resolved launcher shortcut target matches declared activity.
New row has expected NOTE/LIST type and exact marker.
Correct editor and overview tile appear.
environmentRequirements: 支持静态App shortcut的launcher

features.name: 清空整个回收站
features.expectedOutcome: 清空确认只永久删除DELETED集合及无剩余引用附件，Notes/Archived完整。
acceptancePoints: Exactly all DELETED IDs removed; Notes/Archived canonical snapshots unchanged.
Cleanup preserves files still referenced by surviving notes.
Deleted empty state and other folders visible set agree.
environmentRequirements: 只含测试数据的回收站/共享附件fixture

listItems.nullableEncoding: For these two nullable fields only, the pinned JSONObject converter may omit a null value; canonical read may normalize absent and null to null. Do not invent an order or timestamp.
listItems.oracle: Compare the entire ordered persisted field sequence, every body occurrence count, and reconstructed parent/child groups against explicit before/after fixtures. Use distinct body markers for individually tracked tasks. For intentionally indistinguishable duplicate tuples, preserve multiplicity and position/group; do not claim durable identity across restart.

limits: Mapping a control to a planned scenario does not prove it was exercised.
This is a functional inventory at one source commit, not a claim that every pixel, locale, Android version, input-method or dynamic OS surface has been enumerated.
Parameter variants remain separate required coverage slots; template success cannot cover unattempted variants.
Crash/error UI, full accessibility/localization/device matrix and every historical database schema require additional discovery beyond this inventory.

coverage.claim: Source inventory and test plan only; no device coverage claimed.
